convention: Lowercase j = native audio frame; i = pre-thinking chunk; z = result; U = actual user request; Q = private prompt.

symbols.name: Evaluation case and number of distinct questions
symbols.definition: N=105; alternatives and timing branches are not extra questions.

symbols.name: Model, transcript-tool pipeline and pre-thinking-goal choice
symbols.definition: Separate model identity from input-source and prompt conditions.

symbols.name: Input waveform on the source clock
symbols.definition: Original meeting prefix plus the inserted spoken request; no resumed future meeting audio.

symbols.name: Native S1 transport frame and the last frame at request end
symbols.definition: j indexes small model-dependent frames; 480 ms is not universal.

symbols.name: Shared pre-thinking boundary and its integer index
symbols.definition: i is an index, not a reasoning result.

symbols.name: Audio in pre-thinking chunk i
symbols.definition: Contiguous views of the same samples fed to S1; chunk grouping changes, content does not.

symbols.name: Request onset and request end
symbols.definition: Only chunks completed before S_e may produce reusable pre-thinking; final answers condition through T_e.

symbols.name: Spoken request and its exact text
symbols.definition: U names the user question; Q is reserved for private instructions.

symbols.name: Ground-truth speaker-attributed transcript available through t
symbols.definition: At the final request, append the synthetic question text because it is absent from the original AMI transcript.

symbols.name: Transcript produced by ASR/diarization pipeline v
symbols.definition: Contains generated words, anonymous speaker identities, timing and revision versions; no future corrections are silently backfilled.

symbols.name: Input history at the request and at chunk i
symbols.definition: Either GT text, generated text, or audio, as declared by the condition.

symbols.name: Private pre-thinking instructions issued through chunk i
symbols.definition: Task goals come from policy g and past information; future user questions stay hidden.

symbols.name: Shared final-answer instruction
symbols.definition: The same answer-format instruction is used in every paired condition; suppressed in the probability formulas.

symbols.name: Generated private result for chunk i
symbols.definition: Optional native pre-thinking trace plus a visible private artifact, such as facts or checked implications; i remains only the chunk index.

symbols.name: Earlier pre-thinking results and the results available before this request
symbols.definition: Keep prior results where feasible; record exactly which are retained under a capacity fallback.

symbols.name: Native thinking generated for the actual user request
symbols.definition: Observable native reasoning for the actual request; include any additional request-conditioned reasoning calls in the accounting rather than relabeling them pre-thinking.

symbols.name: Answer text, output waveform and the native response object
symbols.definition: R may contain speech and text; it is the response in the S1 probability model.

symbols.name: Independent ASR transcript of generated answer speech
symbols.definition: Used to score S1 audio, with direct listening when names/numbers are disputed.

symbols.name: Model-specific input audio representation and output acoustic codes
symbols.definition: These can be continuous embeddings or discrete codes; neither is a text thinking token.

symbols.name: Tokenization with model m’s tokenizer
symbols.definition: Use model-native generated token IDs when available; flag counts recovered by retokenization as approximate.

symbols.name: New native thinking tokens generated for the request
symbols.definition: Excludes all earlier pre-thinking and the final answer; N/A for a missing or unexposed channel.

symbols.name: New answer-text and protocol/control tokens
symbols.definition: Report separately from native thinking and acoustic tokens.

symbols.name: All tokens generated by earlier private pre-thinking calls
symbols.definition: Includes native pre-thinking and saved artifacts; excludes input-prompt tokens, which have their own ledger.

symbols.name: New request-time text output and request-time input tokens
symbols.definition: Earlier results read again count as input, not newly generated thinking.

symbols.name: Verified reference answer and required source-supported facts
symbols.definition: Never provided to an evaluated model or the pre-thinking worker.

symbols.name: Binary complete-answer judgment and accuracy over all 105 cases
symbols.definition: Partial facts and unsupported claims are also recorded; missing outputs remain in the denominator.

symbols.name: History selection rule and capacity allowance
symbols.definition: Apply a declared rule when full history overflows; never select using gold facts or scoring labels.

symbols.name: Other request-time generated text
symbols.definition: Ordinary output of any request-time helper; the main plan uses deterministic history selection, so this is zero unless an extra helper is declared.

symbols.name: Frozen model parameters
symbols.definition: The selected checkpoint for model m; native mode, precision, prompt and decoding configuration are recorded alongside it.
